claim: For the 9-model primary cohort, API Costs uses AA total evaluation cost in USD. Plan Costs divides the same AA value by the highest eligible subscription Value Multiple selected for that model. The site defaults its cost slider to the primary Cost weight and re-ranks when the user changes cost basis or weight.
method: Read AA evaluation cost and model-specific route multiples; calculate plan cost as AA evaluation cost divided by selected route multiple, then rank lower costs higher.
